# Colorado.gov

> > Official portal for Colorado state government providing access to public services, air quality monitoring, business resources, and executive information.

Colorado.gov serves as the central digital gateway for Colorado residents, businesses, and visitors to access state services including myColorado, DMV, business registration through MyBizColorado, and real-time environmental monitoring from CDPHE. The site provides critical public health information, government contacts, and official executive orders from Governor Jared Polis.

## Key Topics

- Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment (CDPHE)
- Air Quality Index (AQI)
- Front Range air quality monitoring
- National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS)
- Wildfire smoke management
- Governor Jared Polis
- MyBizColorado business services
- Air Pollution Control Division
- EPA air quality standards
- Ozone monitoring and forecasts
- Health advisories
- WCAG accessibility compliance
- Executive orders and appointments
- Emergency services and fire protection

## Core Services & Portal

- [Home | colorado.gov](https://www.colorado.gov): Colorado state government portal homepage with myColorado and DMV access
- [Business | colorado.gov](https://www.colorado.gov/business): Business resources, registration, licensing via MyBizColorado
- [Contacts Search | colorado.gov](https://www.colorado.gov/contacts-search): Directory of Colorado state agency and county government contacts
- [COPRRR | DORA - COPRRR](http://coprrr.colorado.gov/): Colorado Office of Policy, Research & Regulatory Reform oversight page

## Air Quality Monitoring & Advisories

- [CDPHE - Colorado.gov/AirQuality](https://www.colorado.gov/airquality): CDPHE air quality monitoring for Colorado and Front Range regions
- [Current Air Quality Advisories](https://www.colorado.gov/airquality/aqidev/colo_advisory.aspx): Current air quality advisories for Front Range and Denver areas
- [Air Quality Reports](https://www.colorado.gov/airquality/report.aspx): Colorado air quality monitoring reports and pollution forecasts
- [Spanish Air Quality Advisories](https://www.colorado.gov/airquality/spanish_fr_adv.aspx): Spanish-language Front Range air quality advisories and alerts

## Air Quality Technical Resources

- [Air Quality Index Details](https://www.colorado.gov/airquality/aqi_detail_dynam.aspx): EPA Air Quality Index calculation details and methodology
- [Air Toxics Data Repository](https://www.colorado.gov/airquality/aqidev/air_toxics_repo.aspx): Air toxics and ozone precursor data repository from CDPHE
- [Technical Documents Repository](https://www.colorado.gov/airquality/tech_doc_repository.aspx): Technical documents repository for Colorado air quality monitoring

## Governor's Office & Executive Actions

- [2023 Executive Orders | Colorado Governor Jared Polis](https://www.colorado.gov/governor/2023-executive-orders): 2023 executive orders and board appointments by Governor Polis
- [2021 Executive Orders | Colorado Governor Jared Polis](https://www.colorado.gov/governor/2021-executive-orders): 2021 executive orders, pardons, and appointments by Governor Polis

## Emergency Services & Public Safety

- [FAQs | Elk Creek Fire Protection District](https://elkcreekfpd.colorado.gov/faqs): Frequently asked questions about Elk Creek Fire Protection District
- [Address Signs | Elk Creek Fire Protection District](https://elkcreekfpd.colorado.gov/support/address-signs): Emergency address sign program for faster home location by responders

## News & Updates

- [Articles | colorado.gov](https://www.colorado.gov/articles): Press releases and announcements from Colorado state agencies

## Optional

- [Accessibility Standards | colorado.gov](https://www.colorado.gov/accessibility-standards): WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and compliance statement
- [Accessibility Progress Report | Colorado Governor Jared Polis](https://www.colorado.gov/governor/accessibility-progress-report): Governor's Office accessibility compliance progress per HB21-1110
